consignment.guide_overview_notice: Consignment has separate agreements and receipts, but shares inventory and the sales screen. An agreement defines terms only. Posting a receipt adds new stock. Do not use it for goods already recorded on a purchase invoice.
consignment.guide_agreement_notice: Saving an agreement defines supplier items and settlement terms only. It does not change stock quantity or ownership, or convert earlier purchases and sales to consignment. Invoice import here only populates agreement items.
consignment.guide_receipt_notice: This receipt records newly arriving goods. Posting adds every listed quantity to current stock and records supplier ownership. Do not enter goods already recorded on a purchase invoice again: that would count the stock twice.
consignment.guide_post_effect: A draft does not change stock. Posting increases physical stock and consignment quantity together; it does not convert existing stock to consignment.
consignment.guide_ownership_body: Goods you hold and sell for a supplier who retains ownership until sale under the agreement. The same supplier can supply ordinary purchases and consignment. A default consignment setting does not reclassify earlier documents. Physical inventory includes both business-owned and supplier-owned goods, with ownership and value tracked separately.
consignment.guide_agreement_body: Choose a supplier and add multiple items or variants to one agreement. A fixed unit amount is what the supplier earns per unit sold. A percentage is the supplier share of sales after item and invoice discounts and before sales tax, not profit above cost. Example: sale 200, discount 20, share 70% gives 126 before settlement tax. Saving the agreement does not move stock.
consignment.guide_import_body: It saves item-entry time. Fixed amounts use the selected invoice cost, or the latest posted invoice cost per item when importing all invoices. Percentage mode applies the entered share to newly imported items. Existing agreement items retain their terms. The original purchase is not converted to consignment and its stock or sales are not transferred to the agreement.
consignment.guide_receipt_body: Use it when new consignment goods actually arrive. Select the agreement and add items, quantities, lots and expiry dates where needed. Add line places an item in this receipt. Saving a draft does not affect inventory; posting increases quantity and records supplier ownership without creating an ordinary purchase or supplier payable at receipt.
consignment.guide_example_body: You recorded a purchase of 6, sold 2 and accepted a restock return of 1: stock is 5. Creating an agreement leaves it at 5. Posting a new consignment receipt for 6 makes stock 11 because it records 6 additional units. For new consignment goods, use a consignment receipt without also recording an ordinary purchase for the same delivery.
consignment.guide_mixed_body: Do not create another item card. Example: 5 ordinary units and 10 consignment units appear as 15 physical units. The business owns and values 5; the other 10 stay in separate supplier and agreement ownership layers and are excluded from business inventory valuation. Each consignment receipt retains its supplier even when the same item comes from several suppliers. A sale without an explicit source follows the saved removal order; batch-tracked stock follows its batch and expiry policy, and the final source allocation is frozen. Scanning an ordinary purchase identity restricts the sale to ordinary stock from that source. To prove the exact physical unit, use a lot, serial number, source label or separate storage location; identical unmarked units cannot reveal which physical piece the operator picked.
consignment.guide_sale_body: Use the usual sales screen. A sale creates supplier obligation when it consumes a saved consignment source. An agreement alone does not make all sales of that item consignment. Earlier sales are not assigned to a receipt created later.
consignment.guide_return_body: A linked return uses the original saved sale sources. For a standalone return, scan the supplier source code or select the verified item source; the customer name alone does not identify the supplier. Unverified returns remain separate in the supplier sales report when showing all sources. A sellable return goes back to the same source; damaged goods are not treated as sellable.
consignment.guide_settlement_body: After sales and returns, create a statement for the agreement and period, review it, then post it to recognize the supplier payable. Record payment afterwards. Creating an agreement or receiving goods is not payment. Settlement tax and payment terms follow the saved agreement.
consignment.guide_reports_body: The consignment report shows recorded consignment sources and obligations. Supplier sales includes purchase sources, consignment and unverified returns according to filters. Gross sold 2 and returned 1 means net sold 1; gross sold stays 2. Selecting one supplier excludes returns not attributed to them. The selected period filters movements.
consignment.guide_existing_body: Converting posted purchases or existing stock to consignment is not currently available. Do not receive the same quantity again. Conversion needs a review of ownership, value, taxes, supplier balance, payments and earlier sales. If a receipt was entered by mistake, review it in Receipts and use reasoned cancellation when allowed. Consumed receipts need correction through their related movements. Do not delete history to change balances.

consignment.supplier_default_consignment_help: This only simplifies new-document selection. A mixed supplier can continue with ordinary purchases and consignment receipts.
consignment.no_posted_purchases: This supplier has no posted purchase invoices in this currency.
consignment.no_importable_items: No active inventory items can be imported.
consignment.search_purchase: Search invoice number, supplier reference or date
consignment.posted_purchases_only: Only posted invoices are shown. Importing does not reclassify them in accounting.
consignment.import_result: Added {added} items, retained {retained} existing terms, found cost changes for {varied} items, and skipped {skipped} invalid lines. Where costs varied, the latest posted invoice was used for review.
consignment.import_result_percentage: Added {added} items with the selected supplier share, retained {retained} existing terms, and skipped {skipped} invalid lines.
consignment.new_receipt_desc: Increase physical custody without creating a purchase or payable.
consignment.new_custody_movement_desc: Remove consignment stock from custody with documented responsibility and financial effect.
consignment.guide_custody_notice: This document removes consignment stock from custody. A good return to the supplier reduces custody only. Supplier-responsible loss or damage creates no new obligation; company-responsible loss or damage records the supplier obligation and loss expense when posted.
consignment.guide_custody_body: Use a supplier-return document for good consignment goods returned to the supplier, or a loss/damage document when goods leave custody. Select the exact receipt layer, quantity and responsible party. Supplier responsibility creates no new obligation. Company responsibility records an expense and an unsettled supplier obligation. Do not use a customer sales return for these cases.
consignment.custody_effect_help: Each line is tied to an exact receipt layer, so the correct supplier stock is reduced without guessing.
consignment.custody_responsibility_help: Select who bears the value according to an approved record. A good supplier return is always supplier-responsible and creates no loss.
consignment.no_open_custody_stock: No open consignment quantity exists for this agreement.
consignment.search_custody_source: Search item, code or receipt layer
consignment.custody_fixed_cost_auto: The recorded supplier entitlement is used automatically: {amount} per unit.
consignment.custody_percentage_value_help: This agreement uses a share of sales and there is no sale for this unit. If the company bears the loss, enter the agreed per-unit compensation owed to the supplier.
consignment.custody_reason_help: Enter an auditable reason such as a damage record or supplier return authorization.
consignment.custody_post_company_effect: Posting reduces physical custody and supplier ownership, and records loss expense plus a supplier obligation for settlement.
consignment.custody_post_supplier_effect: Posting reduces physical custody and supplier ownership without creating a new company obligation.
consignment.custody_quantity_exceeds_available: Quantity exceeds the available amount in the selected consignment layer.
consignment.custody_duplicate_layer: This receipt layer is already included. Edit the existing line.
consignment.custody_responsibility_required: Select who bears the loss or damage value.
consignment.custody_number_required: Enter the custody movement document number.
consignment.custody_reason_required: Enter a clear custody movement reason.
consignment.custody_lines_required: Add at least one document line.
consignment.warehouse_outside_branch: The selected warehouse does not belong to the active branch.
consignment.custody_agreement_invalid: The agreement is unavailable or does not match the supplier or currency.
consignment.custody_quantity_invalid: Enter a valid custody movement quantity.
consignment.custody_liability_cost_required: Enter a positive per-unit supplier compensation.
consignment.request_key_reused: The operation cannot be repeated because its request key was reused with different data.
consignment.custody_not_draft: The document cannot be posted because it is no longer a draft.
consignment.custody_not_posted: The document cannot be voided because it is not posted or was already voided.
consignment.custody_already_in_settlement: This document cannot be voided after its obligation entered a settlement. Void or reverse that settlement first.
consignment.custody_void_conflict: The document changed during voiding. Refresh and try again.
consignment.new_ownership_conversion_desc: Reclassify a proven quantity without increasing physical stock, with approval evidence and accounting.
consignment.guide_conversion_notice: Use this only when goods already exist as enterprise-owned stock and the supplier has approved changing ownership to consignment. Physical stock will not increase. Select a proven purchase source and enter the supplier credit-note or approval reference; the system reduces inventory asset and supplier balance at recorded carrying value.
consignment.guide_conversion_body: Select the agreement, exact proven purchase source and quantity. No new goods are created: the same quantity moves from enterprise ownership to a consignment layer while total physical stock stays unchanged. Recorded carrying value is loaded automatically and posts Dr AP / Cr Inventory plus the supplier sub-ledger credit using the mandatory evidence reference. One source is used per document for clear review; create another document for another source. It can be voided only before the quantity is sold or moved.
consignment.conversion_accounting_effect: This corrects ownership and value; it is not a new receipt. Confirmation keeps physical quantity unchanged, reduces enterprise-owned stock, increases consignment custody, and reduces inventory asset and the supplier balance at recorded carrying value. Verify the supplier credit note or approval first.
consignment.no_convertible_stock: No proven enterprise-owned stock from this supplier is covered by the agreement. Unverified stock cannot be converted by guessing.
consignment.search_conversion_source: Search item, source code or batch
consignment.conversion_selected_source_help: The selected source belongs to {supplier} and carries code {code}. Only this source will be converted.
consignment.conversion_quantity_help: Total physical stock will not increase; this quantity moves from Enterprise-owned to Consignment.
consignment.conversion_evidence_help: Required for accounting review, such as a supplier credit-note number or approved contract addendum.
consignment.conversion_number_required: Enter a valid conversion document number.
consignment.conversion_evidence_required: Enter the supplier credit-note or approval reference.
consignment.conversion_lines_required: Select a source and quantity to convert.
consignment.conversion_agreement_invalid: The agreement is inactive or does not cover the conversion date.
consignment.conversion_duplicate_variant: Use one source per item in a conversion document and create another document for the next source.
consignment.conversion_product_invalid: The item is unavailable or does not use the agreement currency.
consignment.conversion_term_missing: The item is not covered by exactly one agreement term.
consignment.conversion_source_required: Select a proven purchase source or batch.
consignment.conversion_source_insufficient: Requested quantity exceeds the available balance in the selected source.
consignment.conversion_cost_invalid: This stock has no proven positive carrying value. Correct inventory cost before conversion.
consignment.conversion_not_posted: The conversion cannot be voided because it is not posted or was already voided.
consignment.conversion_void_conflict: The conversion changed while voiding. Refresh and try again.
consignment.conversion_use_dedicated_void: This receipt belongs to an ownership conversion. Void it from the Existing-stock conversion record to preserve its source and accounting.
consignment.new_settlement_desc: Review accrued sales and returns before posting supplier AP.
consignment.report_desc: Reconcile received, sold, returned, remaining and payable quantities.
consignment.accounting_boundary_desc: Receipt affects custody only. Sales accrue supplier consideration. A reviewed settlement moves the accrual to supplier payable.
consignment.export_failed: Could not export the consignment report.
consignment.period_balance_note: Received, sold, returned, obligation, settlement and payment are period movements; remaining stock, unsettled obligation and payable are closing balances through period end.
consignment.report_note: Quantities come from immutable custody and obligation ledgers. Open the supplier sales report for product, category, discount and tax detail.
consignment.tax_inclusive: Tax is included in supplier consideration
consignment.currency_mismatch: Every agreement item must use the supplier currency.
consignment.lot_required: A lot number is required for this tracked product.
consignment.expiry_required: An expiry date is required for this product.
consignment.close_agreement_confirm: This agreement will not accept new receipts after closing. Continue?
consignment.quantity_invalid: Enter a valid quantity at the displayed unit precision.
consignment.terms_help: Agreement items define what the supplier earns when each item sells. Invoice import fills items and amounts automatically; review them below. The following fields only add another item manually and can be left empty after import.
consignment.show_all_products: Add a new item for this supplier
consignment.show_all_products_help: Search shows recorded supplier items. Enable this to search the entire catalog for a first delivery of a new item.
consignment.fixed_help: A fixed amount per unit sold: at 80 per unit, two units earn the supplier 160 before settlement tax. Enter the agreed supplier amount, not the customer selling price.
consignment.percentage_help: The percentage applies to the full selling amount after item and invoice discounts, excluding sales tax. It is not a share of profit above cost. Example: price 200, discount 20, supplier share 70%: supplier amount = 180 × 70% = 126 before settlement tax. Item cost is not subtracted.
consignment.term_required: Select an item and enter the agreed amount or percentage.
consignment.limit_reached: An agreement supports up to 500 items.
consignment.receipt_help: Select an agreement, then add received items and quantities one by one. Save collects all lines into one receipt. The same item can have different lots.
consignment.duplicate_receipt_line: This item and lot are already added. Remove that line and add it with the correct quantity.
consignment.recorded_cost_help: Suggested from the current recorded item or variant cost, which may average multiple suppliers. Review and adjust the amount agreed with this supplier. Invoice import uses the selected invoices’ costs.
consignment.no_unsettled_events: There are no unsettled consignment sales or returns for this supplier in the selected period.
consignment.conversion_recorded_cost: Recorded inventory cost to be reclassified: {amount}

stock_sources.empty: No stock is available for this product.
stock_sources.load_failed: The source breakdown could not be loaded. No supplier attribution was guessed.

stock_sources.physical_balance_mismatch: Source balances do not match physical stock. Reconcile inventory before selling.
stock_sources.choose_sale_source_help: Select the supplier and ownership type. The quantity will be deducted only from that source and saved with the invoice and reports.
stock_sources.auto_source_help: The system selects a source using the saved issue order. Choose an exact source when the physical units are known.
stock_sources.insufficient: The requested quantity exceeds this source balance.
stock_sources.consignment_code_hint: The consignment code uniquely identifies its receipt source and can be scanned in sales and settlement returns.
stock_sources.source_mismatch: The selected stock source does not match the supplier, product, or variant. Refresh and select the source again.
